query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `nom035_action_catalog` (
  `id` INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  `level` ENUM('category', 'domain', 'dimension') NOT NULL COMMENT 'Nivel de análisis',
  `levelCode` VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL COMMENT 'Código del nivel (CAT1, DOM_A, DIM_A1, etc.)',
  `actionType` ENUM('preventive', 'corrective') NOT NULL COMMENT 'Tipo de acción',
  `actionNumber` TINYINT NOT NULL COMMENT 'Número de acción (1-5)',
  `description` TEXT NOT NULL COMMENT 'Descripción de la acción',
  `isActive` BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE COMMENT 'Indica si la acción está activa',
  `createdAt` TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `updatedAt` TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  INDEX `idx_action_catalog_level` (`level`),
  INDEX `idx_action_catalog_levelCode` (`levelCode`),
  INDEX `idx_action_catalog_type` (`actionType`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci COMMENT='Catálogo de acciones preventivas y correctivas NOM-035';
